final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias reference: diode-connected nfet sinks IREF
MB ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=2 L=1
* tail current source (mirror ratio WT/WB)
MT tail ibias vss vss nfet W=30 L=1
* NMOS input pair (vinp -> diode side => non-inverting)
M1 x    vinp tail vss nfet W=16 L=0.3
M2 vout vinn tail vss nfet W=16 L=0.3
* PMOS mirror load
M3 x    x vdd vdd pfet W=30 L=0.5
M4 vout x vdd vdd pfet W=30 L=0.5
.ends dut
